item.title: The Intense Battle Over AI Music Profits
item.description: AI can create songs quickly, but the question of who gets paid and how is sparking disputes.

item.title: Portland Soap Box Derby Combines Speed and Spectacle
item.description: At this event, motorless cars race downhill, with designs ranging from cartoon characters to food items.

item.title: U.S. and Iran miss peace talks deadline; Alaska, Florida and Wyoming primaries ahead
item.description: The U.S. and Iran failed to start peace talks by the deadline this week. The prolonged war has drained U.S. resources. Also, key details on Alaska's upcoming primary.

item.title: Child safety trial against Meta begins in federal court
item.description: Opening arguments started in a case where four states accuse Meta, owner of Facebook and Instagram, of knowingly harming children. The trial is underway.
